_readme: Every generated asset goes here: what it is, the tool, the exact prompt, who made it, and the file. This is our proof for the Chroma tool awards (Meshy, ElevenLabs, Rosebud).

models.reference: art/ref/glasgow/ (Sadman's Glasgow trip photos, Buchanan Street)

models.tool: Meshy 7.1 image-to-3D (Ultra 2K, textured, A-pose) -> remesh 30K -> humanoid rig + animations (Talk with Hands Open, Victory Cheer, Shrug, Stand Talking Angry, Walking, Running); belly patch + 1024 texture in Blender (art/blender/otter_belly.py)
models.made_by: Sadman (Claude Code driving Meshy in his browser)
models.notes: 30,960 tris, 4.5 MB; raw Meshy download kept locally in art/meshy/ (not committed, 21 MB); v2 adds Meshy Idle 1 (Idle_02). Face (brows, blinks, voice-driven mouth, blush) is code: src/game/expressions.js

audio.prompt: Soft rounded UI button tap, short wooden pop, clean and friendly, very short
Short bright rising blip, microphone switching on, soft and friendly game UI cue
Cheerful correct-answer chime, three quick rising bell notes with a sparkle, bright and satisfying
Gentle neutral two-note marimba cue, soft and encouraging, short
Playful wrong-answer sound, soft descending cartoon bloop, funny not harsh, short
Level-up fanfare sting, quick ascending arpeggio on bright synth and glockenspiel ending in a shimmer, triumphant game reward
City street ambience in light rain, drizzle on wet cobblestones, a bus passing in the distance, seagulls calling, soft distant chatter of passers-by, seamless loop

30-second instrumental loop. Modern upbeat indie-folk groove with a light, catchy Scottish fiddle hook over acoustic guitar, warm bass and a crisp mid-tempo drum beat, around 110 BPM. Playful and warm, crisp modern production, not cheesy, no bagpipes, no vocals. Steady energy throughout so it loops seamlessly.
3-second instrumental victory sting. A bright, joyful Scottish fiddle flourish rising to a final chord with acoustic guitar strum and a cymbal swell, triumphant and warm, no vocals.

audio.tool: ElevenLabs TTS (eleven_v3) + ElevenLabs Music (eleven_music_v2_5), mixed with scripts/mix-celebration.sh (ffmpeg, the music ducks under the voice)
